human_check: This record is where start-up stops now, and the shape of the stop is the finding. Everything before it compiled - 267 pipelines, the whole world family and the three specialization-constant families after it, so R9 is answered on the console - and then the driver's compiler reached an intrinsic its instruction selection has no case for and took the title with it. The distinction matters for the ask: a shader the driver cannot lower has to come back as a VkResult naming the limit, not as a dead console. The shader is postprocess_frag (m2-shader-capabilities names the five deployed shaders that declare the capability; R_CreatePostprocessPipelines creates postprocess first), and it is the UI pass's second subpass, the only draw in the engine that writes the swapchain image - so this is R10, on the frame path, and the port cannot dodge it. The must_not_contain needle is the absence of a QUAKE ERROR: when a refusal appears here, the driver has turned the abort into a refusal and this record should be replaced by the run that follows.
